meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 把 Slack 接入现有服务:从 channels 分支复制适配器、注册并安装依赖包、跑构建与注册测试,再引导创建 Slack 应用、填 token、重启服务。之后 Claude 能在 Slack 频道和私信里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要求接入 Slack 频道,或在 /setup 流程中需要 Slack 支持时接管;先确认事件用 Socket Mode 还是 webhook 投递。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 接入进来
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖包

say.text: Slack 用 Socket Mode,不需要公网地址
say.note: 事件走 WebSocket,无需公开 URL

say.text: Slack 用 webhook 方式接收事件
say.note: 需要 3000 端口有公网 HTTPS 地址

howto.what_en: Installs Slack channel support: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, adds the pinned adapter package, builds, runs the registration test, collects your Slack app tokens, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Slack, or during /setup when Slack support is needed. It first asks whether Slack should deliver events via Socket Mode or a webhook.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it and installs the package
Events arrive over a WebSocket; no public URL needed
Port 3000 must be reachable over public HTTPS
